title: Full-step (collide+stream) pointwise reference regression + frozen lbmpy-free gate
why_round2: Round 1 (merged #2263) gated single-step *collision* kernels only; the streaming half of the step, the accumulated 30-step trajectory, and the run-time dependence on a live lbmpy install were uncovered. Round 2 closes those three gaps.

G_code_equivalence.rationale: same-operator comparison; owner 15% physics standard is a null criterion here (round 1 calibration, unchanged)

G_stream_crosscheck.metric: eps_scaled_inf of each in-repo streaming kernel vs the np.roll definition
G_stream_crosscheck.rationale: definition-level identity; anything above fp64 noise is a defect

G_conservation.metric: relative drift of total mass and total momentum over 30 periodic steps
G_conservation.rationale: periodic streaming is exactly conservative; drift above fp64 noise means a kernel leaks

G_physics_shear_decay.metric: max over time of |A_measured(t)/A_analytic(t) - 1|, A_analytic = A0 exp(-nu k^2 t)
G_physics_shear_decay.rationale: owner target 3%; >15% unacceptable. Lattice correction is O(k^2) ~ 1% at k=2*pi/64

G_refdata_reproduction.metric: eps_scaled_inf between regenerated and frozen reference arrays
G_refdata_reproduction.rationale: frozen reference data must be reproducible from source, not hand-written

arms.S: stepwise pointwise: reference = definition-stream(lbmpy collision), in-repo = solver.stream(solver.collide_*), 30 steps
arms.X: cross-implementation streaming audit: every in-repo D2Q9/D3Q19 streaming kernel vs the definition
arms.P: physics: shear-wave amplitude decay vs exp(-nu k^2 t)

frozen_reference.purpose: let the gate run on machines without lbmpy (round 1 gate skips there)
frozen_reference.contents: per case: f0, reference states at checkpoints {1,5,30}, sha256 of every array

honest_limits: the streaming reference IS the definition (np.roll), hence algebraically equivalent to any correct gather kernel; it can only expose indexing/order/axis defects, not model errors
collision oracle is round-1's lbmpy construction, i.e. the same OSS truth source; a shared misconception in lbmpy's compressible SRT would not be detected
arms stay in 2D D2Q9 for the stepwise gate (D3Q19 only in the streaming cross-check)
